authority_rules: Keys and policy pins delivered independently of candidate package, manifests and candidate VM
Provider identity and local guest observations require an independently reviewed binding
Owner cannot self-provision provider authority; candidate self-report is never target attestation
Known public software fixture keys are never accepted as physical authority
Unknown, revoked, expired, ambiguous or substituted keys block review
Signature verification alone does not establish historical truth, observation completeness or admission

signature_requirements.canonicalization: canonical_bytes of UTF-8 JSON without signatures field; duplicate keys and nonfinite numbers rejected
